Ubud, Bali, is renowned for its lush jungles and tranquil retreats. Here are some of the top luxury jungle resorts in the area:

**[Four Seasons Resort Bali at Sayan](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Four+Seasons+Resort+Bali+at+Sayan%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
Nestled in the Ayung River Valley, this resort offers private pool villas with river or valley views, exceptional dining, and a renowned spa.

**[Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Mandapa%2C+a+Ritz-Carlton+Reserve%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
Set along the Ayung River, Mandapa provides private pool villas, personalized butler service, and immersive wellness experiences.

**[Capella Ubud](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Capella+Ubud%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
Designed as a luxury tented camp, Capella Ubud features individually styled tents with private pools, blending adventure with comfort.

**[Buahan, a Banyan Tree Escape](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Buahan%2C+a+Banyan+Tree+Escape%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
Embracing a 'no walls, no doors' concept, this resort offers open-air villas with panoramic jungle views, emphasizing sustainability.

**[The Kayon Jungle Resort](https://www.google.com/maps/search/The+Kayon+Jungle+Resort%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
Perched above the forest canopy, this resort provides private pool villas, holistic spa treatments, and romantic dining experiences.

**[COMO Shambhala Estate](https://www.google.com/maps/search/COMO+Shambhala+Estate%2C+Ubud%2C+Indonesia?utm_source=openai)**
_Ubud, Indonesia_
A wellness-focused retreat offering personalized programs, organic cuisine, and luxurious accommodations amidst the jungle.

Each of these resorts offers a unique blend of luxury and immersion in Bali's natural beauty, ensuring a memorable stay in Ubud's enchanting jungle setting.
